advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that leaves INSTANCE_ID_CACHE unset and asserts the instance id is cached to the path derived from REGION_CACHE's directory (and the '.' fallback for a slash-less REGION_CACHE).
evidence: Both tests set the value explicitly: test_observability_timeout_9313.py:737 and :806 both pass `"INSTANCE_ID_CACHE": str(instance_cache)` — the `:-` default branch is never taken.

Named violating input: run with REGION_CACHE=/var/lib/rebar/probe-region and INSTANCE_ID_CACHE unset — the added lines are the sole code choosing where the instance-id is cached, and no test asserts the derived path (/var/lib/rebar/probe-instance-id) is used.
advisory.finding: The newly added INSTANCE_ID_CACHE default-path derivation (deriving from REGION_CACHE_DIR, and the fallback to '.' when REGION_CACHE contains no '/') is untested: both new tests set INSTANCE_ID_CACHE explicitly, so lines 178-180 never execute. A regression there (e.g. wrong parameter expansion) would go undetected.
scenarios: Production deployment relies on the default INSTANCE_ID_CACHE path (env var unset); a bad expansion would cache to the wrong location or fail silently, defeating the fallback the ticket adds.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a case setting only REGION_CACHE (INSTANCE_ID_CACHE unset), let IMDS return a valid i-* id, and assert a probe-instance-id file appears in dirname(REGION_CACHE).

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Assert the full put_metric_data failure log line including the region= field, and cover a put_metric_data call with no --metric-name emitting metric=unknown.
evidence: observability.sh:205 `printf '%s\n' "${1:-unknown}"` and :211 `printf 'unknown\n'` — the unknown fallback is added code with no covering assertion.
observability.sh:221 `"cloudwatch put-metric-data FAILED metric=${metric} region=${REGION:-unresolved}"` — the region= portion of the failure line is not asserted by any test.
test_observability_timeout_9313.py:726 asserts only `"cloudwatch put-metric-data FAILED metric=gerrit_healthy" in logged`.
advisory.finding: The put_metric_data failure log's region field and the metric_name_from_args 'unknown' fallback are untested. Test 1 asserts only `metric=gerrit_healthy` in the log; it never checks the `region=${REGION:-unresolved}` segment nor a call lacking --metric-name (which yields metric=unknown).
scenarios: A put-metric-data call with no --metric-name (or the region-unresolved formatting) regresses; the diagnostic log line the ticket exists to add is silently degraded.
